ios.desc:
Unwind, Recharge and Embrace Calm with Unlearn Stress

Take control of your well-being with Unlearn Stress, the ultimate companion for relaxation, focus and mindfulness. Blending guided breathing exercises with calming self-care stories, this app offers a holistic approach to reducing stress in your daily life. Whether you're looking for a quick mental reset, deeper focus or a moment of peace, Unlearn Stress is here to help.

Our carefully crafted breathing techniques are designed to promote relaxation and mindfulness, while our collection of over 100 short, relatable self-care stories invites you to unwind and let go. Feeling stressed, anxious or overwhelmed? Escape into our stories—whether you choose to read or listen, our soothing narrations will guide you toward a more peaceful state of mind.

New with iOS 17+: Personal Voice Narration
Have your own voice tell the story! iOS 17+ users can now enjoy personal voice narration for an even more personalized self-care experience.

Why Choose Unlearn Stress?

Customizable Breathing Experiences: Tailor your breathing sessions to suit your needs, with different patterns for relaxation, focus and mindfulness.
Narrated Self-Care Stories: Let our calming narrations guide you through each story, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in relaxation, available in both reading and listening modes.
Personalized Story Narration: Exclusive to iOS 17+, use your own voice to narrate stories, enhancing the experience with a personal touch.
Share Stories: Select and Share up to 3 paragraphs to your friends and family to share how you feel at the moment!
Set Reminders for Consistency: Form habits that stick with easy-to-set reminders that encourage regular self-care.
Background Music Support: Play your own music while practicing breathing exercises, creating a personalized ambiance. (note: you must play music in another app)

Features Overview

- Customizable breathing patterns to suit your relaxation style
- 100+ short self-care stories, each designed to calm and center you
- Support for playing your own background music during breathing exercises
- Personal Voice story narration for iOS 17+ users
- Reminder notifications to help you stay consistent with your practice

Your Pocket-Sized Path to Calm Life gets busy, but Unlearn Stress fits into any schedule. Whether you’re starting your day with a mindful moment, taking a midday break to refocus or winding down at night, the app is your reliable companion on the journey to me

android.desc:
Unlearn Stress: Breathe, Relax and Find Peace

Feeling stressed or overwhelmed? Unlearn Stress offers a simple yet powerful way to calm your mind, relax your body and improve your focus. Combining customizable breathing exercises with short, soothing stories, this app helps you build mindfulness and find moments of peace in your day-to-day life.

With Unlearn Stress, choose from a variety of breathing patterns designed to reduce stress, improve concentration and promote relaxation. Whether you prefer to read or listen, our collection of over 100 highly relatable stories guides you through thoughtful reflections on self-care, work, relationships and life’s challenges. Each story aims to bring calm to the chaos.

Key Features:

Customizable Breathing Exercises: Choose from different breathing patterns to suit your relaxation, focus or mindfulness needs.
100+ Self-Care Stories: Read or listen to short, relatable stories that help you unwind, reflect and release tension.
Narration for Every Story: Enjoy calming narrations, designed to immerse you in a relaxing, peaceful environment.
Set Daily Reminders: Build a habit of self-care with reminders to take moments for yourself each day.

Why Use Unlearn Stress?

Stress Relief Anytime, Anywhere: Whether you’re at work, commuting or unwinding at home, Unlearn Stress is your on-the-go companion for mental clarity and relaxation.
Holistic Approach to Mindfulness: Combining breathing techniques with short, meaningful stories provides a balanced approach to stress relief and mindfulness.
Customizable for Your Needs: Personalize your experience by choosing breathing techniques and setting reminders to help you stay consistent.
Take a Moment to Breathe In today’s fast-paced world, stress and anxiety can take over. But with Unlearn Stress, you can take control. Whether you’re looking for a quick breathing exercise to calm down or a short story to reflect on, the app makes it easy to find a moment of peace in your busy life.

Perfect for Everyone: Whether you’re a busy professional, a parent, a student or simply someone looking for ways to reduce stress, Unlearn Stress is designed to help. The relatable stories reflect real-life situations, providing practical ways to relax, reflect and recharge.

Start your journey to relaxation and mindfulness today with Unlearn Stress.

quotes.text:
Hey everyone! I wanted to share what I’ve been working on lately: an app called Unlearn Stress [1] on iOS [2] and Android [3]. It came out of my own struggles with stress and trying to find ways to cope. Some days are just rough and while I’ve had some luck with doctors, I’ve found that stories, especially ones read in my own voice, and breathing exercises really help lift my mood. The app is simple, works completely offline and there’s no data collection like other apps.

My next idea is to use SSML to better control some of the speech and add delays where needed.

[1] https://www.excsn.com/apps/unlearn_stress

[2] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/unlearn-stress-with-stories/id6670419600

[3] https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.excsn.android.unlearn_stress

quotes.text:
I made it for me as I’ve been having episodes with stress with no specific origin. Been to doctors with some luck from one hopefully the recent operation will address another potential issue. Some days I feel down, out of it, just lack of energy and expression and I don’t know why exactly, but hearing some of the stories, even when I’ve heard them before, help with getting out of a slump.

I found that the 'Shaman' breathing exercise (humming “ohmmmmm” on exhale) for 15-30m, on wakeup and before sleep, has been the most helpful for me. Takes about 10m of doing it for my body to really relax my muscles.

I also found being read stories, that are inspired by the things I knew growing up things I know now, things I wish I knew as a kid, tv shows, friends, current events, forums and etc., are very helpful with my own mindset. Everyone's in a different position and being reminded of perspective can be highly motivating. Narration with your own personal voice is fun (Android needs to catch up!). Wish I could have my voice recorded as a child reading some of these ha!

What ‘Unlearn Stress’ offers:
* Guided Breathing Exercises: Quick and easy breathing exercises that you can do anytime, anywhere to help promote relaxation, reduce stress and refocus.
